title: The Voice in the Vent
summary: A man left alone in a dark lift shaft records a message to his daughter, and a voice answers from the vent.

beats.text: Recording. Sunny, if you find this, I did not leave you. I am stuck between floors.
The lift stopped when the power died. Four days. Nobody opened the doors.
Outside, they walk the corridor. I stay quiet, so they leave.
My battery is at nine percent. I am saving it.
Tonight, something knocked inside the vent. Three soft taps.
I tapped back. A voice whispered through the grille: Daddy?
beats.speaker: girl

beats.text: I know her voice. But she is eight floors away.
It asked me to open the hatch. It asked nicely. Twice.
I did not open it. Her photo glowed on my phone, and the voice went silent.
lines: Daddy, I am on the roof. Come up.

beats.text: The hatch clanged open. A rope fell in, and a small torch: Daddy, hold on.
beats.speaker: girl
